newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae group sets May 9 meeting.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae group sets May 9 meeting.

text.p: The Committee to Restore Value, a shareholder group at Student Loan Marketing Association (Sallie Mae), said it has set May 9 as the date for a special meeting at which shareholders will vote on its reorganization plan.
The Committee, a group which includes eight current directors of Sallie Mae, is backing a plan which differs from a management reorganization plan scheduled for a vote on May 15.
A spokesman for the Committee said its meeting would be held somewhere in the Washington D.C. area.
